findings.description: The apple is held continuously in the woman's right hand from 00:00 with no transfer, placement, or occlusion longer than normal handling. At 00:08 the object in the same grip appears as a green-yellow apple with red blush, with a ghosted red round shape at its upper edge, instead of the uniformly red apple seen at 00:06. No visible manipulation or exchange explains the change in kind/appearance of the object while custody never changed hands.
